acceptance: App icon contains official Salini geometry, visible at SpringBoard scale; opaque 1024px asset and contrast in supported appearances.

Empty and populated project states are both honest; existing stored projects survive upgrade and switching audiences.
Real external club pages open only on explicit taps. No fabricated authentication, membership or live business information.
Review implementation and run relevant tests; inspect simulator screens and important actions; commit and push; upload new TestFlight build and record server state separately.
